name: otterlyai
description: Ask about your OtterlyAI brand reports: AI search visibility, monitored prompts, citations, AI-agent traffic, recommendations and GEO audits.

interface.shortDescription: Track your brand in AI search
interface.longDescription:
OtterlyAI tracks how your brand shows up in answers from AI search engines and assistants.

Connect your OtterlyAI account to ask about your brand reports:
- How often AI answers mention your brand, your rank and the sentiment
- Which prompts you monitor, and which of them mention you or your competitors
- Which websites AI engines cite, and how that changes over time
- How AI agents and AI-referred visitors reach your website
- Recommendations to improve your visibility

You can also add prompts, tags and brand reports, and run GEO audits on a page.

Requires an OtterlyAI account.
defaultPrompt: How visible was my brand in AI search over the last 7 days?
Which websites do AI engines cite most for my brand?
Which of my monitored prompts don't mention my brand yet?

positive.description: Lists the brand reports the signed-in account can access.
positive.prompt: Which brand reports do I have in OtterlyAI?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's brand reports with name, domain and country. The reviewer account has one report for otterly.ai in the US.

positive.description: Summarizes a brand report's AI search visibility over a date range.
positive.prompt: How visible was my brand in AI search over the last 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the brand report, then reports brand coverage for the last 7 days, the brand's rank and sentiment, the top cited domains, and a split by AI engine.

positive.description: Lists the websites AI engines cite in a brand report's answers.
positive.prompt: Which websites did AI engines cite most for my brand over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the most cited URLs for the report over the last 30 days, with citation counts, sorted from most to least cited.

positive.description: Shows which monitored prompts mention the brand.
positive.prompt: Which of my monitored prompts mention my brand, and which don't?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the report's monitored prompts with how often each one mentions the brand, and points out the prompts where the brand is not mentioned.

positive.description: Shows the account's plan and usage. This call is free and never counts against the plan's limits.
positive.prompt: What OtterlyAI plan am I on, and how much of my limits have I used?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the plan, its end date, and usage against the limits for prompts, GEO audits, API requests and MCP tool calls.

negative.description: Writing marketing copy is not something OtterlyAI does. ChatGPT should write it without calling OtterlyAI tools.
negative.prompt: Write a LinkedIn post announcing our new product launch.

negative.description: A weather question is unrelated to brand visibility. No OtterlyAI tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Vienna tomorrow?

negative.description: A general cooking question is unrelated to OtterlyAI. No OtterlyAI tool should be called.
negative.prompt: Give me a recipe for a quick vegetarian dinner.
